content:
1. How did you use your growth mindset today to overcome challenges that arose during the math lesson?
2. Which math concepts did you find difficult at the beginning of the lesson, and how have your thoughts about them changed?
3. Did any part of the lesson intrigue you or spark interest in any particular area of mathematics?
4. In what ways did you push your boundaries and step out of your comfort zone during this lesson?
5. What strategies did you develop to understand complex mathematical concepts during the class?
6. How did your perspective towards solving problems change during the course of this lesson?
7. When you encountered challenges or mistakes in this math lesson, what process did you use to move past them?
8. How have you learned to persevere and maintain a positive attitude when faced with difficult math questions?
9. What steps will you take next time when faced with a challenging math problem?
10. How has developing a growth mindset in mathematics affected your overall approach to learning?
